interpretation.baseline: one first record per run; all ratios use that same run baseline
interpretation.bounds: Missing bounds denote a point as entered, not biological certainty. Propagated intervals are conservative; baseline self-ratios cancel exactly.
interpretation.endpoint: Optional endpoint normalization retains the single declared endpoint and the same run baseline; no causal attribution.
interpretation.eta: Approximate float display of 0.5 * log(q); exact classifications use rational bounds.
interpretation.oxygen: Comparisons concern the declared oxygen read, compartment, and assay. dry_inspired_po2 is the nominal dry-gas proxy fio2 * pressure_kpa.
interpretation.row_order: submitted order retained; runs may interleave; no sorting
interpretation.scope: Arithmetic paired-data audit. No inferred tissue, assay, HIF isoform, causal mechanism, or clinical equivalence; no fitted model or derivative from tied clock readings.

limitations: Delivered-gas return does not establish tissue-oxygen return.
A recorded redox difference is a descriptive contrast, not causal identification.
Exact arithmetic preserves entered values; assay uncertainty remains explicit.

model.bounds_semantics: synthetic interval bounds; no probabilistic coverage claim
model.hif_transfer: unassigned; no HIF or EPO values are synthesized
model.name: one-state adaptation with instantaneous oxidant-drive return

oxygen_read.assay: nominal FiO2 times ambient pressure; tissue oxygen unmeasured

source_refs: Constructed finite adaptation example; no participant data or fitted biological parameters.

warnings.message: Additional columns are retained in each row's extra_fields and are not used for inference.

Distinct occurrences share a recorded clock reading; submitted occurrence order is retained. Ties may represent finite clock resolution or left/right jump events. No derivative is inferred from tied timestamps.
